public_body: Board Of Trustees Of The Townsend Affordable Housing Trust
overall: AG found neither the Selectboard nor the Trust deliberated at the Planning Board's January 9 hearing; attendance by members as residents was not deliberation. No violation; advisory note to Trust on caution.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged that a quorum of the Selectboard deliberated during a Planning Board meeting by commenting on a bylaw amendment while attending as members of the public.
allegations.key_passage: we find that Ms. Kell did not attend the Planning Board meeting in her official capacity as a member of the Selectboard but rather as a resident of Townsend.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged that a quorum of the Trust deliberated during a Planning Board meeting, including comments about Trust-owned land, while attending the public hearing.
allegations.key_passage: Based on the specific facts of this case, we find that Ms. Kell’s public comments, and Mr. Werlin’s brief comment, during the Planning Board’s January 9 meeting did not constitute deliberation, notwithstanding the presence of a quorum of the Selectboard and the Trust.
